$comment: The gi-probe build ingest runs (A§5.2 step 5; merged R28, R30): astra-game-launcher 0.5.1's static-pie musl Linux x86_64 binary, released 2026-11-02 with the owner's word (tag v0.5.1 on ede231b; spec pin c7ae74a). bin/fetch-gi-probe.mjs refuses a download whose digest differs. 0.5.1 implements games content round 3 itself (AstraPlugins #129, previously this catalogue's own check alone), judges a descriptor's `mods` (spec §7: mods-invalid, instead of only accepting the table), holds the manifest and a descriptor to TOML 1.0 as the specification parses them (manifest-invalid/descriptor-invalid{reason=toml-1.0}), and reports [integration.link]'s consent digest (link.digest, manifest.md §2.6.1).
